conversation.text:
Police: It seems you received your mother's call.
Police: She should have told you everything, right? Are you going to come to the police station with her?
Respondent: He has never believed in God.
Respondent: He said that no matter how deep you dig, a shovel can never smell the scent of the soil.
Respondent: When the child was so seriously ill before, he never prayed for her even once.
Respondent: So he is simply unwilling to believe.
Respondent: Thanks to my day and night prayers, we received God's grace.
Respondent: He always gets angry at himself for not having the ability to change all of this.
Respondent: Did he really... turn himself in?
Respondent: If it really was him who took her, it might be because of the child support issue. Since the middle of last year, he mentioned it to me several times.
Respondent: He said he was short on money and truly couldn’t come up with the child support.
Respondent: I told him this stage is crucial for the child. I told him to pull himself together as soon as possible. No matter what, Xiyuan is still his child.
Respondent: But he just wouldn’t pray,
Respondent: and still wanted to rely on his own strength to change everything.
